hook.text: Cut an apple and it turns brown in minutes. That brown color is the same enzyme reaction that makes tea, cocoa, and raisins.

buildup.text: Polyphenol oxidase (PPO) enzyme is released when plant cells are damaged. It oxidizes phenolic compounds into brown melanin.

discovery.text: Lemon juice stops browning because ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is an antioxidant.

twist.text: Arctic apples were genetically modified to silence the PPO gene—they don't brown when cut.

climax.text: Tea production depends on controlled browning. Green tea is heated to stop PPO.

punchline.text: One enzyme makes apples brown, tea dark, and cocoa rich.

quiz.question: Why does lemon juice prevent apple browning?
options: Ascorbic acid reverses oxidation before brown pigments form
